mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM data_requests WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND type='delete_account' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id, chat_memory_enabled, voice_retention, followup_enabled, version, updated_at FROM user_privacy_settings WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_privacy_settings(user_id,chat_memory_enabled,voice_retention,followup_enabled,version,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{chatMemoryEnabled},#{voiceRetention},#{followupEnabled},#{version},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_privacy_settings SET chat_memory_enabled=#{chatMemoryEnabled}, voice_retention=#{voiceRetention}, followup_enabled=#{followupEnabled}, version=#{version}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version}-1
